column1: # Open circles of Fig. 4D in Zhang et al. (2023) -- mouse xenograft renal cell carcinoma
# tumor volume as a fold change
# Digitized from page 7 of the article rendered at 1200 dpi (pdftoppm -r 1200). Axis
# calibration from the plotted ticks: 30.90 px/day (col 674.5 = day 0)
# (row 1178.5 = 0 fold). Circle centers located by matching a 20-30 px annulus template
# against each arm's color mask at the measurement days. The combination arm has no
# day-20 row: its circle is crossed by the day-20 axis tick and the match falls below
# threshold. Accuracy is about +/-0.05 fold (marker radius 30 px = 0.24 fold).
